scope: 5 measurement protocols (P1-P5) for bridge bandwidth/latency/fidelity/directional info flow

P1_clm_tension_eeg_alpha_coherence.name: P1 — CLM tension trace ↔ EEG α-band coherence
method: resample mind.tension to common 10 Hz
z-score both
Pearson r and lagged cross-correlation (lag ±30 s)
phase coupling via Hilbert on tension envelope vs α-power envelope
P1_clm_tension_eeg_alpha_coherence.null_floor: 5000 random shuffles of one signal vs other → p<0.05 for PASS

P2_directional_information_flow.name: P2 — Granger / Transfer Entropy bidirectional
method: Granger causality CLM_tension(t) → EEG_α(t+lag) at lag 0.1, 0.5, 1.0, 2.0 s
reverse Granger EEG_α → CLM_tension
Transfer entropy (TE) bidirectional with k=1 history embedding
compare to bootstrap null (block-shuffle 100 reps)

P3_perturbation_clm_side.name: P3 — CLM-side perturbation: inject prompt → measure EEG response
method: block design: 30 trials × (rest 20s + stimulus prompt 20s + post 20s)
stimulus = high-tension prompt (paradox/contradiction) vs low-tension control (neutral statement)
measure CLM mind.tension peak per trial
measure EEG α-desync (ERD) latency and amplitude
paired t-test high vs low tension condition
P3_perturbation_clm_side.key_assumption: user reads CLM output during stimulus window; cognitive load mediates
P3_perturbation_clm_side.control_for_user_only_artifact: P3.B condition = identical prompts presented WITHOUT CLM in loop (user reads pre-recorded text); difference = CLM contribution

P4_perturbation_eeg_side.name: P4 — EEG-side perturbation: eyes-state → measure CLM tension via mediated prompt
method: block design: 20 trials × (eyes-open 30s, type prompt, eyes-closed 30s, type prompt)
Berger effect ensures α-power difference confirmed (state/clm_eeg_berger_real.json)
user types same template prompt in each condition
measure CLM mind.tension trace per response
compare tension distributions across conditions
P4_perturbation_eeg_side.honest_limitation: no direct EEG→CLM wire; coupling routes via user typing/cognition; this measures user-mediated only
P4_perturbation_eeg_side.feasibility_note: if reverse path CLM-aware-of-EEG required, currently NOT IMPLEMENTABLE (no socket)

P5_bridge_fidelity_static.name: P5 — Bridge fidelity / channel capacity (STATIC, no live session)
method: compute information rate (bits/sec) of mind.tension trace using ApEn / SampEn / Lempel-Ziv complexity at 10 Hz sampling
compute information rate of EEG α-band envelope at 125 Hz
compute mutual information I(CLM_tension; EEG_α) on archived parallel session
Shannon channel capacity bound C = max I(X;Y) over input distributions
identify bottleneck: tension scalar (1 channel × 10 Hz × ~3 bits ≈ 30 bits/sec) vs EEG α envelope (1 channel × 125 Hz × ~4 bits ≈ 500 bits/sec)
P5_bridge_fidelity_static.decisive_question: is bridge bandwidth ≥ measurable signal floor? if no → all P1-P4 are statistically underpowered

ranked_sequence.rationale: decides whether bridge has sufficient bandwidth to carry measurable signal — gates all downstream
first live-session test of mediator hypothesis H1; reuses single 30-min user EEG session
establishes causal direction; requires interactive read-CLM-output session with EEG
tests reverse path; honest scope = user-mediated only
